data.body:
Descoped from epic 77e3: the `blocks` link to 77e3 has been removed (the
`discovered_from` link to e508 is retained — the provenance is accurate).

Operator scope call: evals are out of scope for the complexity-reduction
program, on the grounds that running an eval does not reduce complexity.
2fb4 is eval-fixture calibration, is not tagged `complexity-reduction`, and
had attached itself to the program only through this blocking link. It
should not gate the epic's close.

This does not invalidate the work or the finding recorded in the previous
comment. The implemented repairs (6 fixtures, `ADVISORY_EXPECTS`, 2 unit
tests, `make lint` exit 0) stand in `.rebar/worktrees/impl-2fb4`, uncommitted.
AC5's unreachability — an 11.5% per-case false-fire rate against a gate that
needs ~1.4%, with no temperature or seed available on
`anthropic:claude-opus-4-8` — remains this ticket's own open question, to be
settled on its own schedule rather than as a prerequisite for 77e3.
